svg.title: A labeled neuronal membrane and its gates
svg.desc: Original single-cell calculations using the current public report’s HH voltage convention. One-millisecond pulses start at1ms; shaded region marks the pulse. These are neuronal model outputs, not cardiac action potentials. The split exponential updates keep gates within0and1.
